capabilities: Sync a vault or one folder with a Cloudflare Artifacts repository via commit, pull and push
Run sync manually, on a timer, or shortly after a note changes
Stop on conflicts and keep both versions instead of overwriting data
Set up the namespace, repository and tokens from settings without a command line
Connect a second device to an existing repository and surface notes changed by others
extras: Requires Cloudflare's Workers Paid plan; repository limited to 1 GB and files to 32 MB; tokens expire (auto-renewed when an API token is set); Japanese documentation exists in README.ja.md; conflict resolution currently requires an external Git client, with automatic keep-both handling planned.
intentEvidence: your notes get history and an off-device copy without a GitHub account
motivation: The README says Artifacts gives "history and an off-device copy without a GitHub account", implying the author wanted Git-style sync without GitHub.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is paid and closed, and Git-based sync usually needs a GitHub account and a Git client on each device.

relations.evidence: Both sides use the same Git engine (isomorphic-git)

requires.name: Cloudflare API token (or a manual remote URL and repository token)

summary: Git-based sync that mirrors a vault or one folder to a Cloudflare Artifacts repository, with commit/pull/push in one command or on a timer.
